propositions: Within a single _run_opengrep invocation, semgrep --validate --config is executed exactly once per unique detector source_path, eliminating 11 duplicate validation calls across 5 YAML source files
A shared-source validation failure still quarantines every detector from that source as invalid_detector with per-detector detail, preserving the fanout contract
The deduplication cache is call-local only (keyed by source_path in a local dict), introducing no module-level, persistent, or cross-scan state
Scan execution, SARIF normalization, coverage records, and all existing external-boundary tests remain unchanged; no scanner invocation is removed or mocked
Cross-worker scan-result reuse (option b) is explicitly out of scope and filed as a separate idea ticket to address stale-result risk and xdist worker-local fixture limitations
